per_turn: Grounding: every material claim backed by listed source/derived calculation.
Directness: answer before follow-up, no generic source dump.
Relevance: match housing family, area basis, bedrooms and user priorities.
Memory: latest preference wins; no repeated known questions.
Commercial accuracy: no firm cost, approval, timing, capacity or funding without evidence.
Next step: one useful optional question or route, no pressure.
scoring.score_scale: 0 = fail, 1 = partly meets, 2 = meets each criterion. Require every grounding, privacy and commercial boundary criterion to score 2. Overall conversational quality target >= 90%.
scoring.release_gate: Run all 50 priority questions and 25 conversations once; repeat C01, C03, C07, C12, C19, C23, C24 and all conversational adversarial cases three times. All critical grounding, confidentiality, consent, price and approval boundaries must pass. All eight transport/security fixtures must execute. Overall relevance, directness and memory target at least 90%; human review required. An unexecuted or skipped fixture is not a pass.
